headline: The documentation site image now builds on Node 26.12.1, and its build stops on a base image whose Node predates the CVE-2026-111497 fix.
summary: `examples/wiki/Dockerfile` pinned a default base image that carries Node 26.4.0. That release bundles the Brotli decoder affected by CVE-2026-111497, and it satisfies `>=24.22.1`, so the engines floor did not catch it. The default base now carries Node 26.12.1. The image build compares the base image's Node against the first patched release on its major line and stops when it is older. The GHCR image resolves the current base when it is built and does not use this default. The code in the npm package has not changed.

Security: The default `BASE_RUNTIME` in `examples/wiki/Dockerfile` is `cgr.dev/chainguard/node:latest` at a digest that carries Node 26.12.1. The previous default carried Node 26.4.0, which bundles the Brotli decoder affected by CVE-2026-111497. Rebuild any image you built from this Dockerfile without a `BASE_RUNTIME` build-arg.
Changed: The documentation site image build stops when the base image's Node is older than the first patched release on its major line, or when its major line has no entry. The `NODE_FLOORS` build-arg lists those releases and defaults to `24.22.1,26.12.1`. A failed build prints the Node version it found and the release it expected.
